appearances.title: LeRobot 0.7 trains directly from the Hub with streaming and LanceDB datasets
appearances.summary: LeRobot 0.7 streams only the video bytes each worker needs, reporting 0.52% of step time spent waiting for data on pi0.5 with 4 H100s and a 10.7 TB dataset. It also reads LanceDB datasets and adds multi-GPU training docs.

appearances.title: LeRobot v0.7.0: interactive robot prompting, world action models, diskless dataset streaming
appearances.summary: Hugging Face LeRobot v0.7.0 is live. You can talk to a running robot policy without stopping it, train world action models and new VLAs with FSDP2/HSDP, stream Hub or LanceDB datasets without downloading them first, and run big policies on a remote GPU via lerobot-policy-server. Blog, docs, and GitHub release notes are linked.
